edits.before: - Miss Fortune Bullet Time: matchup-defining — The channel deletes grouped fights — spread, interrupt, and never clump in her cone. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Spell Shield like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
